recipe.visualDefinition: A composite image featuring a high-contrast black-and-white group portrait of four men set within a central black square, framed by a colorful, folk-style landscape illustration of mountains, trees, and clouds. The design uses a layered 'window' effect with bold, textured typography at the top and center.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome human subjects against a stark black void
Vibrant illustrated border contrasting with central dark photography
Textured, flag-patterned title centered above the subjects
Upper display text overlapping the illustrated sky and central frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four men in a staggered group arrangement, filling the lower two-thirds of the central black square.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central black square containing the band members' faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top display text, moves down to the flag-patterned title, then to the faces, and finally outward to the illustrated landscape border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of solid black in the central frame to isolate the subjects.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (highlights on faces, clouds, and text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red, White, and Blue (flag texture in title)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast monochrome photography surrounded by medium-saturation, multi-colored folk illustration.
paletteRestrictions: Primary colors for the flag motif
Natural greens and blues for the border

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Wide, geometric sans-serif with a heavy drop shadow
Center text: Bold slab-serif with distressed flag-pattern texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Drop shadow on top text creates a 3D effect against the sky
Internal clipping mask for the center title to show stars and stripes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Wide sans-serif for names paired with a textured slab-serif for the thematic title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric 80s feel of the top text
Provides the heavy slab-serif structure needed for the flag texture

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a folk-art style landscape border featuring mountains, green hills, and blue sky with white clouds. In the center, place a large solid black square. Inside the black square, place a high-contrast black-and-white photograph of four men in dark clothing, lit with dramatic side-lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary text in a wide, bold sans-serif at the top with a heavy black drop shadow. Add the secondary title in the upper center of the black square using a bold slab-serif font filled with a distressed American flag pattern.

verificationChecks: Is the central frame a perfect black square?
Does the top text have a distinct 3D drop shadow?
Is the center text textured with a flag pattern?
Is the landscape border in a painterly, folk-art style?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the portrait
Intensity of the flag distress texture

mustAchieve: Clear separation between the illustrated border and the photo frame
avoid: Soft gradients in the black frame

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black square is not transparent.
Check that the flag texture is confined within the letterforms.
Verify the drop shadow on the top text is hard-edged.
Confirm the landscape border surrounds all four sides of the black square.
recipe.reuseFormula: Stark monochrome portrait + black geometric frame + folk-art landscape border + wide geometric display type with drop shadows.
